description: This file is a shell script for uploading logs from a device, including functions for local log management, compression, and uploading via HTTP or TFTP protocols, with conditional logic based on device state and configuration.

methods.name: backupAppLogs
methods.description: Copies application log files if they exist from source to destination directory.

methods.name: renameRotatedLogs
methods.description: Renames rotated log files using an external script if available.

methods.name: processLogsFolder
methods.description: Processes logs in source directory, backs them up, and renames rotated logs.

methods.name: modifyFileWithTimestamp
methods.description: Renames log files with a timestamp suffix, avoiding certain files.

methods.name: copyAllFiles
methods.description: Copies all relevant log files from LOG_PATH to DCM_LOG_PATH, excluding specific directories.

methods.name: copyOptLogsFiles
methods.description: Copies all logs from LOG_PATH to DCM_LOG_PATH.

methods.name: HttpLogUpload
methods.description: Uploads log files via HTTP using curl, handling redirects.

methods.name: uploadDCMLogs
methods.description: Compresses logs and uploads via HTTP or TFTP depending on configuration.

methods.name: uploadLogOnReboot
methods.description: Handles log upload process during device reboot, including backup, compressing, and uploading logs.
